arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python - <<'EOF'
src = open('/app/submission/planner.py').read()
old = '''import json
import sys
import time

import numpy as np'''
new = '''import json
import os
import sys
import time

# Keep numerical library thread counts modest (must precede numpy/scipy).
for _var in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ.setdefault(_var, "4")

import numpy as np'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('/app/submission/planner.py','w').write(src)
print("patched")
EOF
